title: The night bus counted one too many 🚌

hook_text: At 11:48 in the evening the bus driver counted one passenger too many.

scenes.narration: At 11:48 in the evening the bus driver counted one passenger too many.
I was alone on the top deck. I had been since the depot. I knew, because I had counted the seats.
The driver's voice crackled over the speaker. Eleven on board. Eleven. I looked down the stairs. Ten empty seats.
Then I heard the bell. One soft ding. From the seat directly behind me.
My mum texted. Are you on the night bus? Sit downstairs by the driver. Whatever you do, never sit upstairs.
I was upstairs. I turned my head, very slowly. The seat behind me was empty. But the window beside it had a handprint, on the inside. Warm, and fogged.

The speaker clicked once more. Correction, said the driver, quietly. Eleven on board, including the one who never got off. I looked at the window. Behind me, a person sat in the glass. And I had no reflection at all.
So tell me. Do you get off, or stay seated?
